sources.read_evidence: Downloaded complete 523-page PDF and inspected complete indicated arguments in extracted text. Theorem A.2.2's proof asserts that a nonzero indicator of a spectral singleton has nonzero Borel-calculus image; that step is invalid for continuous spectrum. The scaffold uses spectral support and a separated relatively open set instead. Definition A.1.1 was reread in full at printed pp.305–306; the A.3 definition at printed p.318 explicitly notes that left/right terminology is often reversed. The local proof therefore uses the repository’s stated L_U and R_U formulas and supplies both estimates directly.
